name: Relevance
description: Measures how well the response fits the context of the conversation. It evaluates whether the continuation logically follows the preceding dialogue and stays on topic.
scale: 1 to 5, where 1 is irrelevant and 5 is highly relevant.

name: Engagement
description: Assesses the level of engagement the response generates. This includes the introduction of new, interesting topics or questions that encourage further dialogue.
scale: 1 to 5, where 1 is not engaging and 5 is highly engaging.

name: Coherence
description: Evaluates the logical flow and clarity of the response. A coherent response should be easily understandable and free of contradictions.
scale: 1 to 5, where 1 is incoherent and 5 is highly coherent.

name: Originality
description: Measures the uniqueness and creativity of the response. This considers whether the response introduces fresh perspectives or ideas that are not clichéd or overly predictable.
scale: 1 to 5, where 1 is not original and 5 is highly original.

name: Empathy
description: Assesses the response's ability to recognize and respond to the emotional tone and cues given in the conversation. This includes demonstrating understanding and sensitivity to the conversational partner's emotions.
scale: 1 to 5, where 1 is not empathetic and 5 is highly empathetic.

name: Linguistic Quality
description: Evaluates the grammatical correctness, spelling, and overall language quality of the response. A high-quality linguistic response will be free of errors and well-structured.
scale: 1 to 5, where 1 is poor linguistic quality and 5 is excellent linguistic quality.
